summary: Security update for the Linux Kernel RT (Live Patch 27 for SUSE Linux Enterprise Micro 6.0)
details:
This update for the SUSE Linux Enterprise Kernel 6.4.0-50.2 fixes various security issues:

The following security issues were fixed:

- CVE-2026-53224: sctp: validate embedded INIT chunk and address list lengths in cookie (bsc#1270023)
- CVE-2026-53246: sctp: validate cached peer INIT chunk length in COOKIE_ECHO processing (bsc#1270024).
- CVE-2026-64530: net/sched: cls_api: Handle TC_ACT_CONSUMED in tcf_qevent_hand (bsc#1271867).
- CVE-2026-64600: xfs: resample the data fork mapping after cycling ILOCK (RefluXFS) (bsc#1271543).
